[Gentlemen](../others.html#248)
I am much obliged for the [draft for £10](../others.html#172) received this morning as well as the copies of the [Story of the Christians and Moors](../books.html#126), which I am very glad to have in this cheap form. I am much obliged for your liberality in the matter, and
remain &c

C M Yonge
